title: fish tank
content: does anyone else’s mall world have a giant escalator with a fish tank underneath of it? in my mall world the fish tank worked as some kind of portal so that people from underwater worlds like mermaids could explore the mall too. in my mall world experience a mermaid swam up to the glass in the under the escalator tank and pressed her hand against it, and i pressed my hand to hers from the outside. my mall world had people from all kinds of different reality’s in it, so i was curious if anyone had seen the escalator fish tank as well.
